config.name: ral-mechanism-v2
config.primary_estimand: coverage interaction: (restart-warm) with branches minus (restart-warm) without branches
config.prediction_status: Retrospective three-way split of a previously inspected dataset; not a pristine new-data test.
secondary_contrasts: restart_branch_effect: restart planning, wam_branch minus wam_demo
future_vs_current_branch_policy: reactive policy, wam_branch minus current_branch
current_branch_vs_demo_policy: reactive policy, current_branch minus current_demo
restart_branch_vs_bc: wam_branch restart planning minus bc policy
the primary interaction and all four contrasts above for success rate
descriptive_outcomes: success rate, mean maximum coverage and episode length for every condition, method and training seed
selected-plan checks along each planner's own trajectory: plan error, expected gain, real gain
wam_* prediction on test demonstrations: factual state nMSE, persistence, counterfactual nMSE, zero-action reference, block position RMSE
config.precision_rule: Seed count fixed at the maximum of 15 by the ral-mechanism-v1 precision rule. On v1's development bank, 2026-10-23, the projected final-bank 95% half-width for the primary interaction was 13.0 pp with 5 seeds and 5.8 pp with 15, against a 5.0 pp target. dev-precision is reported for information only and does not change this study's seed count.
config.derived_from: ral-mechanism-v1: identical code, data, conditions, endpoint and analysis. Only the seed count and the final control bank change. v1's final bank, 3,000,000-3,000,999, was never evaluated. Development banks reuse v1's scheme, so seeds 10-14 keep their v1 development starts.

compute.note: Wall time of the final invocation in each stage; resumed runs also spent time in earlier invocations.

report.inference: Paired training-run Student-t intervals. Secondary intervals are descriptive and unadjusted. Normality is uncertain with few runs.
report.descriptive_note: Condition summaries, plan checks and prediction metrics are descriptive; the predeclared contrasts are in effects.
report.prediction_status: Retrospective three-way split of a previously inspected dataset; not a pristine new-data test.

dev_precision.rule: Seed count fixed at the maximum of 15 by the ral-mechanism-v1 precision rule. On v1's development bank, 2026-10-23, the projected final-bank 95% half-width for the primary interaction was 13.0 pp with 5 seeds and 5.8 pp with 15, against a 5.0 pp target. dev-precision is reported for information only and does not change this study's seed count.
dev_precision.note: Variance components only drive the decision; development effects are recorded for transparency.

anonymized: Absolute dataset paths replaced for double-anonymous review; contents and hashes otherwise identical to the cluster extract.
